summary: Location review completed using isolated DB-backed handler tests and React/Jest tests. Backend: 9/12 passed (new regression suite 7/10). Frontend: 51/53 passed (new regression suite 2/4). Four distinct defects found; application code was not modified. No public HTTP or Playwright tests were performed because frontend/.env and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL are absent; local routing suggested in the request was not used under the public-endpoint-only testing constraint.

critical.issue: Location snapshot is absent from every history response. Reproduced with a stored generation whose location is 'A city rooftop at noon.'; response row has no location key. server.py:8997-9004 SELECT omits g.location, preventing History from displaying the new field.

minor.issue: Replacing strategy.scene.location on a legacy saved project retains contradictory old place data. Expected rooftop; returned 'A city rooftop at noon. A quiet kitchen at night. A wooden table.' server.py:5077-5080 merges incoming scene into unnormalized legacy scene before normalization, which appends the old place fields. Normalize existing legacy fields first, then apply explicit Location replacement.

minor.endpoint: Legacy strategy normalization on project read/update
minor.issue: Non-Latin place details disappear: merge_legacy_location({'environment':'東京の公園','background':'桜の木'}) returns only '東京の公園.'. ai_service.py:3889 ASCII-only normalization turns both comparison keys into empty strings and deduplicates distinct descriptions. Use Unicode-aware comparison and guard empty normalized keys.

ui_bugs.component: History context classification and deep links
ui_bugs.issue: Location-only results are classified as lacking context; deep links choose the 'without' side. hasCopyContext in historyRepair.js:123-124 ignores location, while GenerationHistory.jsx includes location in its context-card condition. Two focused Jest assertions fail.

integration_issues.issue: History UI reads row.location, but /api/history/generations never returns it. Generation detail API does return the correct immutable snapshot in isolated handler tests.

action_items: Select and return g.location in the History endpoint; keep generation snapshot semantics rather than joining the current project's location.
Normalize old scene values before applying explicit strategy.scene.location edits, so replacement does not append retired place values.
Include location in History hasCopyContext and its deep-link classification.

Provide the configured public URL and then verify Review textarea editing/saving, Location selector, strategy rebuild, History display, and overflow at requested desktop/mobile sizes. These browser flows remain unverified in this run.
Rerun the two new regression files after fixing the defects.
